section: 1/1/20251/1/2027Enacted by Chapter 35, 2024 General Session2024Definitions.As used in this chapter:"Cannabinoid product" means the same as that term is defined in Section 4-41-102."Licensee" means a retailer that holds a valid license under Part 2, Licensing, to sell a cannabinoid product."Retail price" means the amount charged by a retailer for a cannabinoid product."Retailer" means a person that sells a cannabionoid product to a consumer for personal use.
